issues.description: Missing shebang and docstring. Code style rule 1 requires conanfile.py to start with '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and a docstring like '"""Conan recipe — txt2man 1.7.1 (makefile)"""'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' as the first line and add a docstring '"""Conan recipe — txt2man 1.7.1 (makefile)"""' after the shebang.

issues.description: url = "" is a template placeholder. Code style rule 5 prohibits empty url in merged code (should be filled by the adapter with the recipe repository URL).
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://github.com/mvertes/txt2man" or the archive repository URL.

issues.description: Missing shebang and docstring. Code style rule 1 requires conanfile.py files to have a shebang line and docstring.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add '#!/usr/bin/env python3' and a docstring such as '"""Test package for txt2man 1.7.1"""'.

issues.description: patch_description does not follow the required format. Rule 12 requires patch_description to be space-separated and start with the patch number, e.g. "0001 Makefile". Current value is "Add DESTDIR support for staging install".
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description to "0001 Makefile" or "0001 Makefile add destdir support".

issues.description: JSON is not 2-space indented. Rule 15 requires 2-space indentation for commands.json. The entire file is on a single line.
Unused import 'os'. The 'os' module is imported but never referenced in the test_package conanfile.py (file operations use the builtin open()).
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the 'import os' line from test_package/conanfile.py.

issues.description: upstream_check_command is set to "make check" but the upstream Makefile has no 'check' target. This is inaccurate, though upstream_test_in_build is false so it won't cause build failures.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set upstream_check_command to "" or remove it, since txt2man has no upstream test/check target.

issues.description: build_date inconsistency: the package-level manifest.yaml has build_date "2026-07-15" while the version-level manifest.yaml has build_date "2026-06-15". notes.md shows build started 2026-06-15 and ended 2026-07-15.
issues.fix_suggestion: Align build_date values across both manifest.yaml files to use a consistent date.

issues.description: The manifest declares cc: clang and cxx: clang++ but txt2man is a pure shell script tool that does not require a compiler. This is misleading metadata.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider setting cc/cxx to empty or adding a note that the compiler is not used for this shell script project.

issues.description: patch_classification marks platform_only: True for the 0001-Makefile.patch, but the DESTDIR support patch is a generic improvement needed for staging installs on any platform, not OHOS-specific. The guard field is also 'pending'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider setting platform_only to False since DESTDIR support is a general portability improvement, and classify the guard.

summary: Audit of txt2man 1.7.1 Conan recipe — VERDICT: PASS. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. P0 checks: (1) test_package actually runs the txt2man binary and verifies man page output — not an empty shell (R34 PASS); (2) status is honestly 'built', not forged as 'published' (PASS); (3) sha256 verified correct by downloading the official GitHub tarball and computing hash — matches '4d9b1bfa2b7a5265b4e5cb3aebc1078323b029aa961b6836d8f96aba6a9e434d' (PASS); (4) no pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19 PASS); (5) no #ifdef __OHOS__ empty stubs (R8 PASS). P1 checks: recipe correctness is sound — package_type='application' correct for a shell script tool, settings='os','arch' appropriate, build()/package()/package_info() correctly handle shell script binaries and man pages, version 1.7.1 matches upstream, source URL is official GitHub. Patch 0001-Makefile.patch verified clean and applies correctly to original Makefile. commands.json exists with type='tool' (R38 PASS). 5 P2 code standards warnings (missing shebang/docstring, empty url, patch_description format, JSON indentation) and 5 P3 suggestions (unused import, inaccurate upstream_check_command, date inconsistency, misleading cc/cxx, patch classification).
